compatibility_corrections.description: Set PYTHONPATH to each corresponding unchanged source checkout for baseline and mutant validation.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: The native baseline failed during test collection because the built wheel omitted svp/version.txt, causing svp/__init__.py to raise FileNotFoundError.
compatibility_corrections.reason: Importing the unchanged checkout is an environment-only path normalization that supplies the package data present at the frozen revision without patching source or changing workflow semantics.

compatibility_corrections.description: Prepended each corresponding environment bin directory to PATH for baseline and mutant validation.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: After source-path normalization, candidate extension loading failed with RuntimeError: Ninja is required even though the documented Ninja dependency was installed, because the clean isolation PATH did not expose its executable.
compatibility_corrections.reason: Exposing the already-installed environment executable is an environment-only PATH normalization and does not change candidate source, dependencies, workflow, or research semantics.

compatibility_corrections.description: Provisioned the upstream-CI-supported Python 3.9 runtime independently in baseline-conda and mutant-conda using the public Miniconda3-py39_24.1.2-0 Linux archive, then repeated the documented setup symmetrically.
compatibility_corrections.prior_failure: With Ninja exposed, native extension compilation under host Python 3.12 failed because Python.h was unavailable.
compatibility_corrections.reason: The frozen upstream GitHub Actions workflow explicitly tests Python 3.7, 3.8, and 3.9 and states that the contemporary PyTorch stack did not support Python 3.10; the demonstrated header/build failure justified provisioning a documented historical runtime.

frozen_case.candidate_evidence: train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.5, random_state=2021, stratify=y) -> train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.5, random_state=2021, stratify=None)

screening.final_failure: After all three bounded corrections, the unchanged baseline workflow still failed during test collection because svp.multiclass imported the removed private scikit-learn symbol sklearn.utils._message_with_time. The frozen split was not executed.
